summary: Iter30 per-product wholesale (Harga Grosir) tested end-to-end. Backend 14/14 new tests pass (migration of all 6618 pgs-official simple products verified = exact legacy values, pgs-9849 tiers correct, /admin/pricing GET/PUT 404/405, no-tier product single row, per-type tiers + pengecer fallback, cart unit price by qty for demo (langsung), 422 validations, variant products save {}, editor GET returns tiers, bulk up_pct scales tiers + history). Frontend: editor (new & existing) Harga Grosir section works (pills w/ counts, implicit first row, range labels 1–5/6–11/12+, fallback note + Salin, add/delete, inline error on publish, publish saves + history), detail page table only when tiers exist, product card range only then, admin index/Akun no 'Pengaturan Harga', /admin/pricing route unmatched. Found 1 real bug: bulk 'set' price mode leaves tiers untouched/unvalidated (qty 6 becomes more expensive than qty 1 and product becomes un-publishable). Plus stale text on legacy admin manual-tier page and mobile overflow in tier rows. No deprecated expo packages detected.

critical.issue: Reproduced: product price 10000 with langsung tiers 6:9000/12:8500, reseller 1:9500 -> bulk set 8000 returns 200 updated=1, but tiers unchanged: price_tiers become [1:8000, 6:9000, 12:8500] (buying 6 costs MORE than 1), reseller 9500 > langsung 8000, price range 8000-9500. Subsequent editor re-publish of the unchanged form fails 422 'harga tingkat dengan jumlah lebih banyak tidak boleh lebih mahal'. RCA: product_bulk.py:173 'if mode != "set"' skips tiers and new_price() never runs the tier validation. Same risk for Excel import price updates. Fix: in set mode scale tiers proportionally (new/old) or skip product with reason when any tier > new base price.

minor.issue: Legacy admin manual-tier endpoint still active and only uses clean_tiers (no duplicate/monotonic/min Rp100 validation, unlike editor). Either remove (editor now owns tiers) or reuse product_editor.validate tier rules.

Range is computed over ALL customer types (price_matrix). A Pembeli Langsung viewer of a product that only has reseller tiers sees 'Rentang harga' including the reseller price but gets no wholesale table (tiers.length==1). Consider range from the viewer's own price_tiers.

Once a type has its own table it fully replaces langsung table: reseller with only 1:9500 pays 9500 at qty 12 while langsung pays 8500. By design per docstring, but editor gives no warning; consider hint in UI.

ui_bugs.issue: Stale copy references removed global settings: 'Jika satu kategori pelanggan dikosongkan, harga mengikuti Pengaturan Harga umum' and 'Mengikuti pengaturan umum'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/admin/product/[id].tsx:70,75. Menu entries still in admin/index.tsx:18 and (tabs)/akun.tsx:32 — duplicate of editor Harga Grosir; consider removing or retexting ('mengikuti Pembeli Langsung').

issues: Tier row overflows: 'Harga / pcs' input extends beyond the card's right edge (clipped) because inner View has minWidth 220 + range label width 90 + delete 44 (wholesale-section.tsx:74,101); delete icon wraps onto its own line making each tier ~140px tall. Stack range label above inputs on narrow screens or drop minWidth.
Table header is English ('QUANTITY', 'DISCOUNT (%)') in a Bahasa Indonesia app — use 'JUMLAH', 'HEMAT (%)'.
Inline tier errors only appear after pressing Simpan/Publikasikan (duplicate qty typed live shows no error until submit) — acceptable but could validate live.

action_items: HIGH: product_bulk.py new_price(): handle tier_prices in 'set' mode (scale proportionally or skip with reason) and validate tiers after any bulk/import price change so qty tiers never exceed the base price.

Update/remove legacy admin manual tiers page text 'Pengaturan Harga umum' / 'Mengikuti pengaturan umum' (app/admin/product/[id].tsx:70,75); consider removing menu 'Harga Manual per Produk' since editor owns tiers; add validation to PUT /admin/products/{id}/tiers if kept.
Fix tier row overflow on mobile in wholesale-section.tsx (minWidth 220 / range width 90).
Optional: compute price range from viewer's own tiers; localize detail table header.

product_editor.validate and form.ts validateForm are consistent (dup qty, <Rp100, monotonic incl. implicit harga jual for langsung). Frontend additionally checks min_qty<1.
